block.label: Section_2
block.builder:title: ATTITUDES, NEEDS, AND WANTS
block.html:
You qualify to take the rest of the survey!
The purpose of the survey is to determine your preferences and opinions about pursuing your [pipe:hDEGREE].
For the next few questions, please think about colleges and universities in general.

radio.label: Q16
radio.title: Which of the following best describes where you are in your process of choosing a school?
radio.row: I am just beginning to explore schools or programs

I am ready to apply or have already started applying

radio.label: Q17
radio.title: After finding a school you’re interested in, how likely would you be to do each of the following?
radio.row: Explore information on the school’s website on your own
Use interactive tools (e.g., cost calculators, program finders)
Request more information (e.g., fill out a form or email the school)
Speak with an advisor by phone
Schedule a time to speak with an advisor
Apply directly without speaking to anyone
radio.col: 3 ${" – " if gv.request.device.isMobileDevice() else ""} Neither likely nor unlikely

block.html: FastTrack is DeVry University/Keller Graduate School of Management’s competency-based education offering. In this approach, students progress by demonstrating mastery of specific skills or knowledge areas at their own pace, rather than following a fixed course schedule. Students may move more quickly through material they already know and spend more time on topics they need to learn.
